Name: Chat Commands Lite
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Adds the ability to use the SMAPI console commands in the chat box, does not enable the usage of mod-provided commands however. Also does not include the other fancy features included in the original Chat Commands mod, hence this being named a "lite" version. I just needed a solution for when debugging during modding as having to tab-out to the console repeatedly can be a tad annoying.


[b]Commands that can be used:[/b]

[b][code]/list_items
/player_add
/player_setmoney
/player_changecolor
/player_changestyle
/player_sethealth
/player_setmaxhealth
/player_setmaxstamina
/player_setname
/player_setstamina
/hurry_all
/set_farm_type list
/set_farm_type
/world_clear
/world_downminelevel
/world_freezetime
/world_setday
/world_setseason
/world_settime
/world_setyear
[/code][/b]

Downloads.Description: Fixed mistake in previous version where command history wasn't displayed correctly
